legend.official: Official name: printed by Rockstar or a console store.
legend.reported: Reported name: read off the car on screen or given by the outlet; Rockstar hasn't listed it.
legend.strong: Strong match: two or more independent car outlets name the same real car.
legend.likely: Likely: one car outlet names it, without hedging.
legend.possible: Possible: the outlet hedged ("probably", "to my eye", "maybe").
legend.disputed: Outlets disagree: the sources name different real cars.
legend.none: No real-world match established by a reliable source.

sections.title: Named by Rockstar: launch bonus vehicles
sections.intro: These names come straight from Rockstar and the console stores (Ultimate Edition and the pre-order bonus). Those listings don't name any real-world inspiration, so the real-car line is a sourced match from car outlets or left blank.

cars.role: Jason's "well-worn" low-riding pickup; the Ultimate Edition adds a Ganado Retro Build
cars.why: The Drive identified a hero Vapid "modeled after the real-life Ford Ranchero" in Trailer 2, before its name was public. Rockstar later described the Ganado as Jason's low-riding Vapid pickup. Linking the two is our inference, so we call it likely, not confirmed.

cars.role: Ultimate Edition: "Grotti's signature mid '90s sports car" with a retro-futuristic livery
cars.why: No car outlet had tied this exact model to a real car by Nov 17. (The Drive matched the older Grotti Cheetah Classic to the Ferrari Testarossa; see Trailer 1 below.) Since launch, the guide sites GTABase and GamerBlurb say the '95 is based on the Testarossa too (see the finder above). Separately, West Coast Customs built a real-life Grotti Cheetah, described by Hypebeast as a mid-engined '90s supercar with a 4.9-liter naturally aspirated V8.

cars.role: Ultimate Edition: a "Mud Club monster" for the backwoods of Mount Kalaga, kept at the Paradise Garage in Watson Bay
cars.why: Not identified by a reliable source yet.

cars.role: Pre-order bonus (Vintage Vice City Pack), comes with a garage
cars.why: Not identified by a reliable source yet.

cars.role: Ultimate Edition: Jason's Army-fatigue safehouse motorcycle
cars.why: Not identified by a reliable source yet.

cars.role: Ultimate Edition: pink-and-blue boat at Washington Beach
cars.why: Not identified by a reliable source yet.

sections.title: Trailer 1 (December 5, 2023)
sections.intro: Car-spotting from The Drive (Dec 5, 2023) and Jalopnik (Dec 6, 2023).

cars.role: Lined up with other exotics on a main road
cars.why: The Drive: 992 Porsche 911. Jalopnik: "undoubtedly inspired by the modern Porsche 911 Cabriolet".

cars.role: '80s wedge in the exotic line-up
cars.why: Both outlets name the Testarossa.

cars.role: Red GT car, returning from GTA V
cars.why: Both outlets name the V12 Zagato.

cars.role: Seen in Trailer 1 and again in Trailer 2 traffic
cars.why: The Drive names the C8 Corvette in both trailers (one outlet). West Coast Customs' real Coquette build uses a 6.2-liter V8.

cars.role: The orange car Jason and Lucia drift at the end of Trailer 1; back again in Trailer 2
cars.why: The Drive says it shares much with a second-gen Chevy Malibu "circa 1970" and calls it a "Malibu knock-off" in Trailer 2. Jalopnik says it "most resembles a Chevy Chevelle". In that era the Malibu was the Chevelle's top trim, so both point at the same car.

cars.role: Lowrider on a mural-lined side street
cars.real: Buick Riviera (1st gen) or Chevrolet Impala
cars.why: The Drive: "similar to a first-gen Buick Riviera". Jalopnik: the blue lowrider is Impala-inspired. West Coast Customs later built a real Buccaneer as a 1960s lowrider with a 7.5-liter V8.

cars.role: Pink donk in the same street scene
cars.real: Chevrolet Malibu (4th gen) or Chevrolet Monte Carlo
cars.why: The Drive: "giving fourth-gen Chevy Malibu". Jalopnik: the hot pink car is Monte Carlo-inspired.

cars.role: Parked in the lowrider scene; a "High Rollerz" club car later
cars.why: Both outlets point to the Chrysler 300.

cars.role: At the convenience store in the final shots
cars.why: The Drive: "GMT400 Sport Side bed". Jalopnik: "single cab, stepside GMT400".

cars.role: Vice City police cruiser, plus a pink civilian one doing donuts
cars.why: Both outlets spot Crown Vic-style cruisers. The Drive also sees Ford Explorer-based Police Interceptor Utility and Ford Taurus interceptors; Jalopnik sees a Chevy Tahoe-style SUV.

cars.role: A woman stands up in it about 24 seconds in
cars.why: The Drive calls it "an amalgamation" of those cars.

cars.role: Just ahead of the Zorrusso
cars.why: The Drive: its closest cousins are "probably" those two.

cars.role: Passing the exotic line-up; an interior shot came with Trailer 2's images
cars.real: Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat mixed with Chevrolet Camaro
cars.why: The Drive, in both trailer write-ups (one outlet).

cars.role: Striped roadster at the top of a frame in Trailer 1; at an intersection in Trailer 2
cars.why: The Drive, in both trailer write-ups (one outlet).

cars.role: In opposing traffic in the lowrider scene
cars.real: Mid-'60s Lincoln Continental or late-'60s Chrysler New Yorker
cars.why: The Drive offers both, with "or maybe".

cars.role: Silver car passed by a dirt-bike gang
cars.why: The Drive.

cars.game: '80s muscle car in the road-rage scene (name not reported)
cars.role: Road-rage clip
cars.why: Jalopnik.

cars.game: Dually pickup at the gas station (name not reported)
cars.role: Filling up at the pumps
cars.why: Jalopnik.

cars.role: Out of focus in an early highway shot
cars.why: Jalopnik, which spots an NSX-like car again in the Extended Look.

cars.role: Modern pickup a main cast member (Brian) arrives in; "Caracara" is on the hood decal
cars.why: The Drive reads the decal: a caracara is a bird of prey, "you know, like a raptor".

cars.role: One tows a jet-ski; a dual-rear-wheel Bison drags a safe or vault
cars.why: The Drive calls the Bison "a Ram equivalent".

cars.role: At a Vice City intersection with the Banshee and Comet
cars.why: The Drive.

sections.title: "An Extended Look" (August 27, 2026)
sections.intro: Car-spotting from Jalopnik (Aug 28, 2026) after Rockstar's 26-minute gameplay video.

cars.role: Jason's red convertible: the first driving gameplay we see
cars.why: Jalopnik, which also notes a hardtop Sentinel already exists in GTA Online.

cars.game: Red hero muscle car (name not reported)
cars.role: Jason breaks into it after the opening mission
cars.why: Jalopnik: "seemingly inspired by the Chevy Chevelle".

cars.role: Black sedan in the big police chase
cars.why: Jalopnik. A newer Schafter at the closing car meet looks like a pre-facelift W213 E-Class.

cars.role: The black SUV the player drives out of the airport
cars.why: Jalopnik calls it "very obviously inspired by" the Cullinan here; The Drive spotted a green Cullinan lookalike in Trailer 1.

cars.role: The common cop car in the chase
cars.why: Jalopnik ("not the Ford Taurus like it is in GTA V").

cars.role: The player's car in the new circuit racing
cars.why: Jalopnik. Rivals on track look like a Challenger, a Charger, GTA's Mustang equivalent and an Infiniti G35.

cars.role: Stickered night street race, with neon underglow
cars.why: Jalopnik.

cars.role: Same night street race
cars.real: Porsche Cayman; Lamborghini Diablo; Ferrari SF90
cars.why: Jalopnik: Cayman, plus two exotics that "to my eye" look like a Diablo and an SF90.

cars.game: Hypercar at the party (name not reported)
cars.role: A partygoer films themself in the driver's seat
cars.why: Jalopnik.

cars.role: Rumbles past a jogger in Vice City
cars.why: Jalopnik.

traffic.text: Also spotted in Extended Look traffic, per Jalopnik (likely matches, names not reported): previous-gen Dodge Challenger, Dodge Charger, Audi TT, Ram 1500, 10th-gen Honda Accord, modern Chevrolet Camaro convertible, new-gen Range Rover, Chevrolet Suburban, Toyota RAV4, third-gen BMW X5, a high-performance Cadillac sedan, a big Lincoln SUV, a purple C7 Corvette, Audi A4, Mercedes G-Class, a pink Lamborghini-like supercar on a tow truck, a yellow Crown Victoria taxi, Dodge Durango and Buick Roadmaster.

builds.title: Real cars built from GTA 6 cars
builds.intro: Ahead of the launch, West Coast Customs in Los Angeles built real versions of six in-game custom cars. Specs below are from the build sheets as reported by Hypebeast (Nov 6, 2026); they describe the real builds, not in-game stats.

cars.detail: Mid-engined '90s supercar, 4.9-liter naturally aspirated V8, "Vice City fade" paint
Restored 1960s lowrider, 7.5-liter V8, candy-apple green, air ride
Track car, twin-turbo 4.0-liter V8, candy orange
Mid-engined, 6.2-liter naturally aspirated V8, pink and purple "Yeti Camo"
1970s donk, 7.7-liter V8, Vice City blue with gold trim
Mid-engined police build in Vice Beach Police Department livery
